import{useEffect}from"react";import{useLocation}from"react-router-dom";/**
 * React Router preserves scroll position between route changes.
 * This resets it so navigating to a project always starts at the top.
 */const ScrollToTop=()=>{const{pathname}=useLocation();useEffect(()=>{if(window.lenis&&typeof window.lenis.scrollTo==="function"){window.lenis.scrollTo(0,{immediate:true});}else{window.scrollTo({top:0,left:0,behavior:"auto"});}},[pathname]);return null;};export default ScrollToTop;
